Header-Datei #include "ara/diag/doip_trigger_vehicle_announcement.h" class mono Scope class ara::diag::DoIPTriggerVehicleAnnouncement class mono Exception-Sicherheit exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit not thread-safe class mono Parameter (in) th Parameter th Beschreibung td networkInterfaceId td network interface id on which a vehicle announcement shall be sent. Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td ara::core::Result < void > td Returns nothing or an error. Fehler th Fehlercode th Beschreibung td This function does not specify any standardized errors. Hinweise: If the reported DoIPNetworkConfiguration.networkInterfaceId belongs to a DoIPNetwork Configuration with property isActivationLineDependent = TRUE, this is an error as on those interfaces sending of announcements happens automatically after activation line going up/IP address assignment.
